response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and AI-agent infrastructure experience, particularly at re:cinq, where he contributes to Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agentic workflows. While his AI/GenAI experience is not as extensive as the role requires, his technical leadership, cloud platform familiarity, and open-source contributions suggest potential. A deeper dive into his hands-on GenAI work is warranted.
strengths: Proven technical leadership and mentorship across multiple senior roles, including Staff Software Engineer positions.
Hands-on experience with AI-agent infrastructure (MCP, agentic workflows) and cloud platforms (AWS, Kubernetes).
Strong open-source contributions and community engagement, demonstrating passion for cutting-edge technologies.
concerns: Limited explicit evidence of 8+ years building production-grade AI/GenAI solutions (focus appears more on full-stack and tooling).
No mention of vector databases, RAG architectures, or LLM performance metrics in resume highlights.
Lacks advanced degrees (Master's/PhD) in AI or related fields, which were preferred qualifications.
